text: Create program is Home's primary, in the header beside View my work; the footnote pointing at the switcher is gone.
Two tinted banners become one grey callout (Mission Computer version 2 and its CVE offer), with one action.
One card a program: name, %, one green bar and "176 of 560 controls satisfied"; the note line under each card is gone.
Other programs is a plain list, each row a link with "0 of 287 controls satisfied" in grey; no dashed rings or Open arrows.
Nine blocks become three: one completion card, Open work and three link rows, beside one Details rail; all above the fold at 1440.
The three mini tiles (Mapped, With evidence, Assessed) are cut; Controls owns them. The card links to Controls.
The control-status strip is the completion card's one bar and the page's one chart, with its legend; 31% and 176 of 560 beside it.
The title carries one status, ATO with conditions; the Lifecycle label moves to Details and the description sentence is cut.
The facts row is gone: Team and Details are one Details rail (program, system, lifecycle, baseline, next date, then the seven roles).
The SSP, setup and assessments cards and the four-lane timeline become three link rows with grey meta; Version history stays a link.
Open work rows lose their red and amber glyphs; colour stays inside the strip. Recent activity and the footnote are cut.
The second Urgent row no longer wraps one word a line: the hidden callout column that squeezed it is gone.
Rows are one hairline list a group, not bordered boxes: icon, title in medium weight, grey meta, avatars.
Jira keys are plain grey text in the meta (WSX-409); the ticket's own state and the red "8d late" go, one state word a row.
Waiting on others' blue ring is grey; the empty avatar is a plain circle; the two footnotes under the lists are cut.
Seven stacked tables become one table with a Kind column and the Kind filter, the record that has waited longest first.
Nothing is ticked when the queue opens; the selection bar replaces the filters only once a row is chosen.
Each kind's View all link and the closing footnote are gone; Requested by is the one last column for every kind.
Settings is a left list of sections (Workspace, My account) beside the page, as Vanta's; the area tab strip is hidden on these pages.
Deadlines is setting cards of rules, one card a group: deadline, what it applies to, its days, On or Proposed. No register.
The Deadline status and Imports cards, the At risk pills and the Items at risk tables are cut; the counts stay on Findings and POA&M.
In use reads as an On pill and Proposed as a grey word; the group tabs drop their counts.
A rule opens its deadline preview, which now carries Disable beside Edit (the v1 group cards held Disable).
My alerts and Workspace tabs are gone: My account › Notifications and Workspace › Notifications are two sections of the list.
Frequencies (Immediately, Daily digest) are grey words, not amber and grey pills; the head is a title and one line.
Named Workspace notifications; the defaults keep On and Off pills, "Off · CUI" reads Off, frequencies are grey words.
The log sits in the Settings frame; each action is an ink word without its green, amber or red glyph; None given reads —.
Three setting cards of rules: Enclaves (Chat On or Off), Markings (each rule On, then the CUI preview), Where AI drafting may run.
You are here is a grey word, not a blue pill; Hosted model and In-enclave pills become words; On and Off are the only pills.
One card of providers, a row each: kind and what WS-X90 inherits in grey, "7 of 15 satisfied" with no bar, authorization in words.
The amber banner is one grey line in the identity provider's row, with Open program; the kind tags and the filters are cut.
In the Settings frame; RMF roles' "One" is a word, not a blue pill; the database's rules are a plain list without green checks.
The subtitle is cut, and so is the second line under Next gate (the gate's name is the date's tooltip).
No ring in each row: Controls satisfied reads "31% 116 of 374".
Next gate is one plain date with a red mark only when it has passed; no flag icons or red and amber dates.
"+2 controls" and "1 behind" are words, not green and amber pills.
One control-status strip with its legend for the page, above the family cards; the 18 cards lose their four-colour stacks.
Added and removed counts are ink, not green and red; the Apply switches are ink when on.
The amber "2 assessments are active" banner is one grey line under the title; the what-if banner stays for a switched-off layer.
The third column, What you're creating, is cut (and its phone disclosure); the Review step's cards and What creating writes carry it.
Step references follow the stepper: categorization is in step 3, Systems; the baseline is chosen in step 4.
The bar title stays 16px: the visual layer's type scale had raised it to the 44px page h1, clipped in the bar.
The what-if message is a line with Back to saved, not a banner the visual layer would drop on a register.
A layer's Changes (+201 −17) are ink, not green and red.
Each layer's added count in Edit overlays is ink, not green.
Inside Settings, switches and radios are ink when on, not blue; blue is left for links.
